pages.title: Framework Assembler
pages.text: Metal nodes and organic struts left to crystallise from a hot solvent, then carefully dried.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the linker length and how fast the solvent is driven off. The pore must fit the target molecule (within a few tenths of an ångström); dried too fast, the pores collapse.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): MOF Gas Sorbent, Metal-Organic Framework, Silica Aerogel.
